entries.text: Removed the wrapper fix-ups (DuckDB `ALL` restore, SQLite interval/EXTRACT/DATE_TRUNC rewrites, SQLite discount-bound fold, TPC-DS date-integer regex), `normalize_dialect_for_sqlglot` and `benchbox/platforms/questdb_rewriter.py`. `resolve_sql_dialect` and `PLATFORM_DIALECTS` map platform keys to runtime dialects; an unknown name raises `UnknownSqlDialectError`. `influxdb` resolves to `datafusion`.
